statement.p: Find the gradient of the function f(x,y,z) = x^{3}\ln\mathopen{}\left(yz\right), at the point (-1,1,e)

static.solution: f_x=3x^{2}\ln\mathopen{}\left(yz\right), f_y=x^{3}\frac{1}{yz}z and f_z =x^{3}\frac{1}{yz}y. Thus \mbox{grad} f = 3x^{2}\ln\mathopen{}\left(yz\right)\,\mathit{\vec i}+\frac{x^{3}\cdot 1}{yz}z\,\mathit{\vec j}+\frac{x^{3}\cdot 1}{yz}y\,\mathit{\vec k} and \nabla f(-1,1,e) = 3\,\mathit{\vec i}-\,\mathit{\vec j}-0.367879\,\mathit{\vec k}.
